skill.name: specdd-do
skill.description: Guides agents through implementation work inside an existing SpecDD project, including bootstrap resolution, spec-chain review, scoped edits, validation, and reporting.
skill.summary: Implement code, documentation, tests, tasks, or specs under active SpecDD authority.

content.value_statement: SpecDD projects need edits that respect active bootstrap rules and local write authority. This skill guides scoped implementation, validation, and reporting.
actual_capabilities: Confirms that a project has `.specdd/bootstrap.md` before using the workflow.
Reads bootstrap files in the defined order and applies later narrowing rules.
Resolves governing spec chains before planning, editing, reviewing, or testing.
Requires clear local write authority before changing files.
Reports specs used, files changed, verification results, and remaining uncertainty.
limitations: Only applies to projects that already use SpecDD.
Does not define adoption steps for non-SpecDD projects.
Does not grant authority beyond the project bootstrap and governing specs.
Requires project tests or validation commands to be available separately.

use_cases.title: Implement a scoped feature
use_cases.description: Make a code change after resolving the governing bootstrap and nearest local write authority.

use_cases.title: Update project documentation
use_cases.description: Change docs while preserving local spec constraints and reporting which specs governed the edit.

use_cases.title: Complete a test-backed task
use_cases.description: Guide an AI agent through a task with relevant checks and a concise implementation report.

prompt_templates.title: Make a Small Change
prompt_templates.prompt: Use specdd-do to update [file or behavior]. Resolve the active bootstrap and spec chain first, then implement the smallest correct change.

prompt_templates.title: Update Documentation
prompt_templates.prompt: Use specdd-do to revise [document]. Confirm write authority, preserve governing constraints, and report the specs used and validation performed.

prompt_templates.title: Implement With Tests
prompt_templates.prompt: Use specdd-do for [task]. Identify write authority, update code and tests inside scope, run relevant checks, and report results.

prompt_templates.title: Handle Conflicting Authority
prompt_templates.prompt: Use specdd-do to assess [requested change]. Compare the active bootstrap and governing specs, stop if authority is missing, and explain the next step.

output_examples.input: Update a validation test in an existing SpecDD project.
output: Resolved bootstrap and governing spec chain.
Reported verification results and remaining uncertainty.

output_examples.input: A user asks to edit a file without clear write authority.
output_examples.output: The agent stops, explains that authority is missing, and asks for the relevant SpecDD contract or operator direction.
The agent checks the nearest docs spec, makes the focused edit, runs available validation, and reports the specs used.

best_practices: Start by confirming the active bootstrap chain before planning work.
Keep edits limited to the nearest spec that grants write authority.
Report verification results and uncertainty after each completed change.
anti_patterns: Using the skill in a project without `.specdd/bootstrap.md`.
Treating similar filenames or conventions as write authority.
Changing unrelated files because they are nearby or convenient.

faq.question: Does this skill adopt SpecDD in a new project?
faq.answer: No. It only applies after a project already has `.specdd/bootstrap.md`.

faq.question: Can it edit files without a local spec?
faq.answer: No. The workflow requires clear write authority from bootstrap rules or governing specs.

faq.question: Does it run tests automatically?
faq.answer: It instructs the agent to run relevant checks when available and within authority.

faq.question: Which files does it read first?
faq.answer: It starts with `.specdd/bootstrap.md`, then optional project and local bootstrap files.

faq.question: Can later bootstrap files weaken earlier rules?
faq.answer: No. They may narrow or specialize rules, but they must not silently weaken project contracts.

faq.question: Is this useful for documentation changes?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers code, docs, tests, tasks, and spec changes under active SpecDD authority.
